chunks: Read your ledger; this day you are sufficient to take your own account.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God says 'Read your book' on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of individual accountability (mas'uliyyah), where one's own book of deeds serves as an undeniable witness, reflecting the divine justice that requires no external mediator. It highlights the psychological and spiritual weight of self-reflection, as the 'book' represents the cumulative impact of one's actions and intentions. This concept reinforces the Shia emphasis on personal responsibility in the absence of intercession without one's own merit.
